description: This file provides logging utility classes and macros for the QUICHE project, including no-op log sinks, fatal and check log sinks, and logging macros with conditional compilation.

classes.name: LogStreamVoidHelper
classes.description: Helper class with operator& to facilitate logging macros.

classes.name: NoopLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that does nothing, used for disabling logs.

classes.name: FatalLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that logs fatal errors and aborts.

classes.name: CheckLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that checks a condition and aborts if false.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Operator in LogStreamVoidHelper with lower precedence than << but higher than ?:.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the internal stringstream for logging.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the accumulated log message as a string.
